d: What is moment of inertia? In this video, we explain moment of inertia in simple words — from the merry-go-round example (why kids sitting on the edge makes it harder to spin) to the formula I = mr², figure skaters pulling their arms in to spin faster, and real-world applications in gymnastics, cycling, cranes, and even doors. Learn why moment of inertia depends on both mass AND how far that mass is from the spinning axis.
